failure_summary.description: Agents missed that the latest turn added criteria to existing results, returning a no-op or searching again instead of retrieving, filtering, and saving the compatible cached result.
An agent imported tools from a nonexistent module despite the existing direct-call instruction.

patch.reasoning: The cache rules already describe reuse and filtering, but the affirmation rule only mentions carrying forward proposed entities or categories. Clarifying that answers to follow-up questions and accepted preferences are active criteria makes the required cache update more explicit. No namespace edit is needed because the skill already prohibits imports.

edits.target: - Resolve brief affirmations such as “yes” against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal, and carry forward the proposed entity or category as stated.
edits.content: - Interpret the latest user reply in context as a possible plan update, including answers to clarification questions and affirmations accepting a proposed preference or entity. Carry forward every explicit value or criterion. If a newly supplied filterable criterion is not reflected in the matching cached result, retrieve the closest compatible result, filter it using all applicable new criteria, and save the update under a unique key. Do not use “No planning needed” until all current criteria are reflected in the relevant cached results.
